data.segment_title: Economy: Rescue Plan / Gas Prices / Stocks

(Studio: Russ Mitchell)  Report introduced.  

(Washington: Thalia Assuras)  The latest rescue plan for the US economy's credit crunch featured; details given about the government's purchasing of troubled financial assets and investing in banks.  [Treasury Secretary Henry PAULSON&nbsp- says we will use taxpayer money with an equity investment plan.]  [Senators Charles SCHUMER, Arlen SPECTER†; Maryland economist Peter MORICI†- react to the plans for banks.]  What happens next with the bank rescue plan discussed.  

(Studio: Russ Mitchell)  The drop in gasoline prices cited.  

(New York: Priya David)  The panic and fear in the stock market examined; stock market, Volatility Index {VIX} and the "stages of market emotion" statistics cited.  [WOMAN&nbsp- says we don't know what will happen.]  ["Fast Profits in Hard Times" author Jordan GOODMAN†- assesses the soaring VIX.]  [Standard and Poor's strategist Sam STOVALL†- says now the perma-bears come out; predicts we are at a bottom.]
